trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَتَوَجَّهٗ اِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ وَآلِهٖ وَاُقَدِّمُهُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ حَوَائِجِيْ فَاجْعَلْنِيْ بِهِمْ وَجِيْهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN. ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ATA-WAJJA-HU ILAIKA BE-NABIYYE-KA NABIYYIR RAHMATE WA AALE-HI WA O-QADDE MO-HUM BAIYNA YA-DAIY HAWAA-E-JEE FAJ-A’L-NEE BE-HIM WAJEE-HAN FID DUNYAA WAL AAKHERA-TE WA MENAL MOQARRA-BEENA.

trans.en: O Allah bless Muhammad and his family. O Allah I turn to You through Your Prophet the Prophet of mercy and (through) his family and I place them in front of my needs, so make me through them, respected, in the world and in the hereafter and from the near ones.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِيْ بِهِمْ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْنِيْ بِهِمْ وَاهْدِنِيْ بِهِمْ وَلَا تُضِلَّنِيْ بِهِمْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ بِهِمْ وَلَا تَحْرِمْنِيْ بِهِمْ وَاقْضِ لِيْ حَوَائِجَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ وَبِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUM-MAR HAMNEE BE-HIM WA LAA TO-A’ZZIB-NEE BE-HIM WAHDE-NEE BE-HIM WA LAA TO-ZILLA-NEE BE-HIM WAR ZUQNEE BE-HIM WA LAA TAHRIM-NEE BE-HIM WAQZE LEE HAWAA-E-JAD DUNYAA WAL AAKHERA-TE INNAKA A’LAA KULLE SHAI-IN QADEE-ROON WA BE-KULLE SHAI-IN A’LEE-MOON.

trans.en: O Allah have mercy on me through them and do not punish me through them and guide me through them and do not lead me astray through them and grant me sustenance through them and do not deny me through them and fulfill my needs of the world & the hereafter. Surely You have power over all things and (You) are aware of all things.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
